description: Use this to upscale a video to 1080p or 4K (30 or 60 fps) with Topaz video upscaling. Priced per second of the INPUT video: 1080p = 15 (30fps) / 30 (60fps) credits/s, 4K = 60 / 120 credits/s — so a 10s clip to 1080p30 costs 150 credits; confirm cost with the user for 4K. Input up to 20 seconds (pass a URL; upload_media for local files). Charged on success only. Jobs take a few MINUTES: the tool returns a job_id — call upscale_video again with just job_id every 30-60 seconds until it returns the finished video URL, then share it with the user. The upscaled video is also saved to the user's BudgetPixel library. The result is an H.265 (HEVC) 10-bit MP4, which some browsers cannot play (black frame with audio) — tell the user.

job_id.description: A previously returned upscale job id — pass it alone to check progress and fetch the finished video URL.

target_fps.description: Target frame rate (default 30). 60 fps doubles the per-second rate.

target_resolution.description: Target output resolution (default 1080p). 4K costs 4x: 1080p = 15/30 credits per input second (30/60fps), 4K = 60/120.

video.description: The video to upscale: an http(s) URL (a generated video's URL, or one from upload_media for local files). Up to 20 seconds, ≤50MB. Required unless job_id is set.

name: upscale_video
title: Upscale Video
